abilities.name: Another Self
lines: Repeats every attack
* Takes 1 hit to prevent damage to user, then disappears
** Pain/poison received before activation does not hit [Another Self]
* Cannot receive Buffs/debuffs/statuses while active
** Does not avoid debuffs from allies
* Doesn't receive Banish effect while active
* Healing works
* Hits from [Another Self] are not calculated separately from main attack
* Does not repeat skills obtained from equipment
This state is invoked by skills that can summon [Another Self]: Galeforce Blade, Burst Wind Blade, Wheel Charge
